justification: Both are upright carved stone slabs bearing registers of relief decoration including a circular motif, but A is a rounded anthropomorphic figure with head, body and stylized limbs while B is a flat rectangular stela with arch-like top elements and animal/figural low relief in a very different compositional scheme. The manner of carving—deep rounded modeling versus shallow linear relief—also differs markedly, limiting the resemblance to a generic 'carved standing stone' impression.
